data.description: Cowboy Draw prize and odds structure

data.text: There are two options for having the ticket terminal generate random numbers for you:
Just ask the clerk for a Cowboy Draw Quick Pick—it’s that easy!
Mark the QP box on your playslip (using pencil, blue, or black ink).
To select your own numbers, fill out a playslip with pencil or blue or black ink. A single playslip offers two sets of numbers.
If you make a mistake, mark the VOID box. DO NOT ERASE.
Play the same numbers for 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, or 20 consecutive drawings! Either mark the Multidraw box on your playslip or tell the clerk how many draws you want.
Every Cowboy Draw ticket is $5 for two sets of numbers (“plays”).
Your ticket is your receipt. It displays:
Please confirm the accuracy of your picks.

Cowboy Draw tickets may be cancelled only by returning the ticket to the retailer that sold the ticket on the same date of purchase. Canceling a Cowboy Draw ticket will also cancel any advanced draws that remain on the ticket.
Your ticket is your property. Protect it by signing your name on the back. If your ticket is lost or stolen, the only way to prove ownership is through your name, address, and signature.

data.name: Keno about — how to play steps

data.text: 1. There are 20 numbers drawn every 4 minutes. Choose how many you want to try to match. Odds vary. See payout table.
2. Choose the numbers you think will be drawn. 1-spot game → pick 1 number. 2-spot game → pick 2 numbers. And so on. Quick Pick generates random numbers.
3. Payout tables are based on a $1 wager. If you wager more than $1, prizes are multiplied by your wager amount.
4. You don’t have to fill out a slip every four minutes. Play the same set of numbers for multiple draws in a row with consecutive plays.
Also: Check your total ticket cost to make sure it doesn’t exceed the maximum ($125).
Disclaimer: The prize values shown here are based on a $1 wager. Multiply larger wagers by the payout amount for total potential winnings. The grand prize limit for all wagers is $200,000.
Also: Approximate overall odds to win a prize range from 1 in 2.27 to 10.34. Approximate odds to win the top prize on the 10-spot game are 1 in 8.91 million.
To play with randomly generated numbers, pick how many spots you want to play, and then fill in the Quick Pick bubble on your playslip.
To play your own numbers, select how many spots you want to play (1-10). Then, pick your numbers (1-80). You have to pick as many numbers as spots.
Mark your playslip with a blue or black ink pen.
Grab tickets on the go from any WyoLotto retailer or hang and play KENO at any number of bars and restaurants across the state.
Your ticket is your receipt. It displays:
The date and number of the drawing
Please confirm the accuracy of your number picks.
To determine total ticket cost, multiply your wager ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $10, $20) by the number of consecutive draws you want to play (up to 20).
There is no limit on consecutive draws (up to 20) for wagers up to $5.
$10 wagers are limited to 10 consecutive draws.
$20 wagers are limited to 5 consecutive draws.
KENO tickets cannot be canceled. It is important you check the accuracy of your playslip with the retailer before finalizing your purchase.
Your ticket is your property. Protect it by signing your name on the back. If your ticket is lost or stolen, the only way to prove ownership is through your name, address, and signature.
Take your ticket to a WyoLotto retailer*
and use the ticket scanner feature
Watch drawings in person at your local hangout
You must redeem your winning tickets within 180 days from the draw date.
for all information on obtaining your winnings.
